query: Assess Akamai Guardicore Segmentation against the full 33-item microsegmentation checklist (standard mode).
assumptions: Akamai Guardicore Segmentation (formerly Guardicore Centra) is assessed as Akamai's microsegmentation product; official techdocs.akamai.com Guardicore pages are SSO-gated, so official Centra guides were sourced from Scribd copies of the Admin/Installation/User guides plus Akamai marketing/brief PDFs and public ReadMe docs.

Agent-resource and latency numeric items (4.1/4.2/4.3) use documented vendor figures (up to 5% CPU / 400MB RAM; latency described qualitatively) and are rated partial because no source confirms the checklist thresholds.
NIST CMVP registry search is treated as authoritative negative evidence for FIPS 140-2/140-3 certification (8.1); Common Criteria portal was inaccessible, so CC status remains unverified.
Vendor-hosted customer stories (e.g., 300,000-endpoint deployment) are treated as case_study evidence, not independent analyst evidence.
Scribd copies of Guardicore training materials (GCSA units) are treated as vendor_doc.

provider_config.primary: direct HTTP fetch (staging helpers) + DuckDuckGo/Bing discovery via reader proxy
